default.notes: A Schengen short-stay visa issued by France is required — Monaco has no border controls with France and issues no short-stay visas of its own; apply through France-Visas.

groups.notes: EU citizens enter freely with a passport or national ID card — there are no border controls between France and Monaco.
EFTA citizens enjoy the same free entry as EU citizens — there are no border controls between France and Monaco.
90 days visa-free under the Schengen rules applied through France — time in Monaco counts within your 90 days in any 180 in the Schengen Area. ETIAS authorisation will be required once mandatory.
Visa-free with a biometric passport under the Schengen rules applied through France: 90 days in any 180-day period. ETIAS authorisation will be required once mandatory.
Visa-free with a biometric passport under the Schengen rules applied through France: 90 days in any 180-day period. ETIAS authorisation will be required once mandatory.

MC.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for Monegasque citizens.

UA.notes: Visa-free with a biometric passport under the Schengen rules applied through France: 90 days in any 180-day period.

RU.notes: A French-issued Schengen short-stay visa is required. The EU suspended visa facilitation with Russia; fees are higher (€90) and processing is slower.

VU.notes: The EU suspended Vanuatu's visa waiver over its citizenship-by-investment scheme; a French-issued Schengen short-stay visa is required.
